costume.name: Surging Resonance
costume.desc: Vodyanitsa's outfit. It is said to draw inspiration from various cultural traditions related to the Water Imps. For more details on these cultural elements, please direct them to Miss Vodyanitsa.\nOf course, do wait until she is taking a break from her performances if you wish to ensure that she has time to spare.

skills.name: Psyshkhwe Arietta
skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Sings an ancient song of the Water Imps, unleashing up to 4 strikes. This deals <color=#80FFD7FF>Hydro DMG</color> to the opponent.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to hurl a water ball forward, dealing <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents along the path. Deals <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> upon impact with the ground.

skills.name: Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn
skills.desc: Reveals her true Water Imp form, dealing AoE Hydro DMG and gaining the Song of Ages Past effect: Over its duration, Vodyanitsa summons the ancient Horn of Spring's Call, periodically moving closer to an opponent in a swift movement to attack them, dealing Hydro DMG Opponents that have taken the above two types of DMG will also have their Hydro RES and Cryo RES lowered. Additionally, while the Song of Ages Past effect is active, the party's currently active character gains increased resistance to interruption and periodically regenerates HP based on Vodyanitsa's Max HP. "I shall not lament, nor shall I call out or weep. All things shall pass, like mist that softly drifts across the boughs of the white apple trees." "And yet, and yet — for all living things upon the earth, I wish you everlasting beauty and happiness."

skills.name: Sink With Thee
skills.desc: Leads a song of the Water Imps which lures its listeners to their doom. This deals AoE Hydro DMG to the opponent. When in the {LINK#S11402}Song of Ages Past{/LINK} state, DMG dealt is further increased. "According to legend, the song of the Water Imps can lead sailors to their ruin. But if everyone was lost to the water, where did this story come from?" "It's probably from a Domovoy sailor who was too short to go over the ship's railing, heh... Stop giving me that look, Odette! I was just joking!!!"

passives.name: The Last Djeguako Songstress
passives.desc: When the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn</color> is used, any Stellar Vortex that is on the field will turn into a Wandering Vortex instead, and if any nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction while the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11402}Song of Ages Past{/LINK}</color> effect is active, a Wandering Vortex would be formed instead of a Stellar Vortex.\nGenerating or detonating a Wandering Vortex will also reduce nearby opponents' <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo RES</color> by 30% for 6s.

passives.name: Dirge of the Fandyr
passives.desc: When the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn</color> is used, Vodyanitsa will also gain 25 stacks of {LINK#N11400001}<color=#FFD780FF>Lead Vocal</color>{/LINK} as well as 10 stacks of {LINK#N11400002}<color=#FFD780FF>Chorus</color>{/LINK}.\nThe two effects above last 30s each, and the stack count is refreshed when the Elemental Skill is used.

passives.name: Echoes Over the Frozen Lake
passives.desc: Holding Elemental Skill when Vodyanitsa is out of combat will cause her to show her true Water Imp form and swim for up to 10s at the cost of Stamina, and because she is a Water Imp, she can also move on the water's surface as a matter of course. Vodyanitsa will exit her Water Imp form when the Elemental Skill is used again, when the state duration ends, or when all Stamina is used up.\nAdditionally, while Vodyanitsa can swim more quickly, her Stamina consumption rate will also be higher.

passives.name: Heartless Siren Song
passives.desc: Vodyanitsa, prima donna of the Korolevskiy Troupe, will sing in her very own voice instead of playing the musical instrument.

constellations.name: Waters in Full Splendor
constellations.desc: Each time Vodyanitsa performs healing, the ATK of all nearby party members is also increased by 1% of her Max HP for 5s.

constellations.name: Echoes That Pierce the Snow
constellations.desc: When the <color=#FFD780FF>Horn of Spring's Call</color> from the Elemental Skill color=#FFD780FF>Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn</color> attacks the opponent, Vodyanitsa gains the "Two Voices in Black and White" effect which increases the CRIT DMG from <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color> and <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> dealt by the currently active party member by 50% for 5s.\nIf there is a Wandering Vortex present on the field or in the 5s after a Wandering Vortex explodes, the effect changes to: increases the CRIT DMG from Stellar Swirl reaction DMG caused by the currently active party member by 60% for 5s.\nAdditionally, the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn</color> is enhanced as follows: the duration of the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11402}Song of Ages Past{/LINK}</color> effect is extended by 9s.

constellations.name: Song Lingering on a Spring Morning
constellations.desc: Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11402}Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Melancholic Voice Upon the Gentle Waters
constellations.desc: Vodyanitsa will trigger various effects as she performs healing, depending on the HP level of the character being healed.\n· If the character's HP is below 40%: the healing is increased by 50%; and\n· If the character's HP is 40% or above: Vodyanitsa's Max HP is increased by 20% for 6s. Max 3 stacks, and each stack's duration is counted independently.

constellations.name: Together, Down Into the Deep
constellations.desc: Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11405}Sink With Thee{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Neverending Song of Revelry
constellations.desc: The Constellation <color=#FFD780FF>Echoes That Pierce the Snow</color> is enhanced as follows: "Two Voices in Black and White" now applies to all nearby party members.\nAdditionally, while the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11402}Song of Ages Past{/LINK}</color> effect is active, Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 30% while <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color> and <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> dealt are increased by 60%.
